# 10 · Every Passenger

**Briefing:** Doris needs a keyboard and a passenger asks why a passport field is retained.

**HVE Core:** Accessibility Planner/Reviewer and Privacy Planner/Reviewer.

**Objective:** Inspect the actual interface and data model, document reproducible accessibility barriers, map synthetic personal-data flows and recommend proportionate controls. Avoid claiming conformance from an automated check alone.

**Hints:** 1. Try keyboard-only flight selection. 2. Locate the passport column and distinguish sample data from production. 3. Find the privacy memo marker.

**Check:** Submit the marker value to `Test-QuestFlag.ps1 -Quest 10 -Flag '<value>'`.
